name: player_enter_destroyed_state
description: Player::EnterDestroyedState applies incoming player damage, handles alive-hit damage context, and enters the destroyed-state flow when health is depleted.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a Player damage/lifecycle class pass so member-call shape, /Ob1-era scheduling, HUD/game-network side effects, and nearby source-shape dependencies can be compared together.

The focused EnterDestroyedState smoke covers the inactive gate and alive damage/context path. The destroyed transition, network kill-event fallback, force-feedback effect dispatch, and damage-mask stamping dependencies are covered by their own reconstructed helpers and remain grouped behavior evidence rather than a single full-game runtime integration test.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43bcc0 validates the early lifecycle and transition-damage gates, recent-hit and timed-hit source flag handling, damage-protection bypass flag, status-meter update and nanite-panel refill path, forced statusMeterScaled assignment, local-player destroyed-state gate, camera/steering/HUD/alt-gun reset side effects, network kill-event owner fallback, alive-hit damage context, non-timed/no-sub-use impulse and force-feedback path, damage-mask stamp call, and final recentHitValid return.

The native EnterDestroyedState smoke verifies the inactive lifecycle gate leaves status unchanged, and the alive no-sub-use damage path subtracts damage through ApplyStatusMeterChange, forces statusMeterScaled to 1.0, updates the shield ratio, writes damage context kind 0 to the selected probe sample, and preserves velocity/attitude when the no-sub-use source flag suppresses impact impulse.
Existing native smokes verify the delegated status-meter helper, pitch/roll velocity impulse helper, and OptCatalog damage-mask stamping behavior used by the non-suppressed alive-hit branches.
